summary: Per-frame per-vehicle camera/physics update tick on the main game frame path. When the scoring gate is set to direct mode it walks the global vehicle array applying wheel contact transforms; otherwise it iterates the receiver's own camera-element array dispatching mode-render physics calls and, on a coarse camera-shake timer, writes shake data for eligible camera structs to a ring buffer.

operations.description: Branch on the global scoring gate being set to the direct-contact mode.
Direct mode: iterate over the global vehicle count, one pass per vehicle slot.
Call a float-parameter sub-routine per vehicle slot during the direct-mode pass.
Compute the wheel contact transform for each vehicle slot base (slot pointer plus an object offset) in direct mode.
Otherwise: iterate the receiver's element array up to the count stored in the first field.
Dispatch the mode-ordered render physics call for each array element with the time argument.

When the scoring gate is in the shake-enabled mode and the stored shake timestamp plus one is older than the current time argument, refresh the camera shake timer and scan for eligible camera structs.
Store the current time argument as the updated camera shake timestamp.
Skip the shake sweep when the element count in the first field is not positive.
Walk the camera element array and write shake data for elements whose per-element state field is not in the excluded state.
Alternate shake path: walk the camera element array and write shake data only for elements neither in the excluded state nor flagged inactive by their flag byte.
Return the element count stored in the first field as the result.
